summary: Frontend UI testing iteration 2 - Comprehensive UI flow verification for JKEE EPC ERP. Tested 13 major UI flows including theme switching, approvals inbox, tender costing, project tabs, multiple module UIs, locked records, admin UI, client portal, and company wizard. Backend APIs already verified at 97.5% in iteration 1.

testing_notes.approach: UI-only testing with Playwright automation. Verified presence and accessibility of all UI elements without executing data-changing actions.
testing_notes.data_preservation: Did not execute actions that would modify data (approvals, submissions, creations) to preserve test environment integrity.
testing_notes.multi_login_testing: Tested with 3 different user roles: admin (super), site engineer (masked fields), and client (portal-only).
testing_notes.theme_verification: Confirmed JKIC theme color #0B3048 by measuring actual sidebar background color in browser.
testing_notes.test_coverage: Covered all 17 UI flows specified in test requirements except vendor portal link (requires email).
